/verify-email: Landing page for the address-confirmation email. Reached from a signed token in the message body; a link to it from the site chrome would be meaningless without that token.
/r: Reached from a QR code on the printed card handed to a customer at the end of every job, not from the site chrome. Deliberately noindex and deliberately absent from the sitemap: it is a tool, and it must never compete with /reviews for the query that matters. A link to it from the footer would put 'leave us a review' in front of people who have not hired us yet, which is the opposite of what it is for.
/well-installed-review/success: The Stripe success_url for EW-0001. Reached only by the person who just paid, carrying the order id the page needs to accept their quote upload; noindex and out of the sitemap. Linking it from the chrome would put an upload form in front of people who have not bought anything, and it would not work for them.
/well-installed-review/report: Where a paying customer collects the finished Quote Intelligence report, gated on the order id and the email that paid. Reached from the emailed link, not the chrome; noindex and out of the sitemap.
/listing-floor-report/success: The Stripe success_url for EW-0003, same shape as /well-installed-review/success: order-scoped, reached only after payment, noindex and out of the sitemap.
